preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard is between 1 and 500.
The length of the permutation list p is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation list p is between 1 and n.
Each integer from 1 to n appears exactly once in the permutation list p.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no solution, or it consists of n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == i for i, line in enumerate(return_value, start=1))
postconditions.description: The i-th line contains exactly i numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= n for line in return_value for num in line.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(return_value[i-1].split()[j-1]) == p[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1) if p[i-1] == i)
postconditions.description: The cell (i, j) on the main diagonal has the number i.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(num) == x for line in return_value for num in line.split()) == x for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The number of cells that belong to the x-th region is equal to x.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(num) == x for num in line.split()) for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each region x has at least one cell.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(return_value[i-1].split()[j-1]) == int(return_value[i-1].split()[k-1]) for k in range(j, i+1)) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1))
postconditions.description: All cells in the same region have the same number.
